MTech students selected as 'Delegates' under IEEE SPACE 2026!

Tanish Jain and Vidhan Jain, MTech final-year students from the Signal and Image Processing specialization, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at NIT Rourkela, have been selected as 'Delegates' under the prestigious 'MTech Initiative of IEEE SPACE 2026'. Notably, they are among only 10 selected delegates nationwide. Both students are working under the guidance of Prof. Sobhan Dhara at PRISM Lab, NIT Rourkela.

Research Topics:

  • Tanish – Aerial Object Detection for Maritime Scene Surveillance
  • Vidhan Jain – Tiny Object Detection in Aerial Scene Surveillance

As part of this initiative, both researchers will receive complimentary full conference registration along with access to technical, plenary, and invited sessions. They will also have the opportunity to interact with leading scientists, researchers, and industry experts, gain valuable exposure to space, aerospace, and defence technologies, network with national and international delegates, and receive a certificate of participation.
